title: European Accessibility Act penalties by member state, with verification status
description: Maximum fines and imprisonment terms under national EAA transpositions, each figure tagged as read in the official text or carried from a secondary source.
intended_use: Exposure briefings for online sellers serving EU consumers; checking vendor claims.
out_of_scope_use: Not legal advice; not a complete list of member states; not a statement of what a regulator would actually impose.

attribution: Secondary figures: Deque Systems, EAA country-by-country compliance data (read 2026-10-29).
collection_method: Read the German and Irish legal texts on 2026-10-29 and the Austrian on 2026-10-30, recorded the penalty provisions; and the French and Spanish on 2026-10-30; the Dutch, Italian, Swedish and Polish on 2026-10-30; the French contravention amounts, the 2026 Dutch fine category, Denmark and Luxembourg on 2026-10-31. SE and PL amounts are not in euro; DK sets no maximum.
known_limitations: All eleven countries are tied to the legal text; open points: LU later amendments not read, FR service scope of R.451-4, DK 2024 amendment not read, PL article number not read.

Finland was searched on 2026-10-31 but its services sanctions (Act 306/2019) could not be read; not included. Belgium was searched the same day: transposition is split across authorities and the final text was not found; not included.
The source of the EUR 500,000 German figure in secondary tables is UNKNOWN.
Maximum statutory penalties say nothing about enforcement practice.
